what: A fixed on-screen SVG line (river, road, trail) draws from start to end across the full document scroll (stroke-dashoffset, no curves, scrub 1.5 — it follows the scroll 1.5s late). At the very top (progress under 1%), a short beam of light (400 units) runs down the same line every 3s — rests at 5%, runs to the end by 85% on cubic-bezier(.89,.42,.54,1), hides, then returns to its start at 91%, with a 1s delay the first time. Scroll down even slightly and the light goes out. Return to the top and it flows again after 1s.

options.scrub: Lag (s) of following the scroll, default 1.5 — 0 ties immediately
options.range: page (default — whole document from start to end) or self (while this element passes through the screen)
options.start · end: range: ScrollTrigger start · end when self, default top bottom · bottom top
options.glint: Light beam length (in line user units), default 400
options.delay: Delay before the light starts to flow when it reaches the top (sec), default 1
options.ease: Light-streak curve — form ”0.89,0.42,0.54,1”, default original value
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Line to draw (a single path) — required
options.[data-fx-part=glint]: (If any) Light-ray line of the same d

use: <svg data-fx="scroll-path-draw" data-fx-scroll-path-draw="scrub: 1.5" viewBox="0 0 236 549" style="position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;height:80vh"><path d="…" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".3" fill="none"/><path data-fx-part="glint" d="…"/><path data-fx-part="line" d="…"/></svg>
note: The line is measured only once (in user units, so independent of board size) — if you change d, remove data-fx and attach it again. To make it draw after the loader ends, attach data-fx when the loader finishes

from.where: shared.js river line — a fixed line drawn by whole-document scroll 1.5s after the loader ends (scrub 1.5) · top light streak (.river-preview, 3s after 1s, cubic-bezier(.89,.42,.54,1), only while progress is under 1%)
